title: web-modernize migration unit
description: Schema for .claude/modernize/units/<unit-id>.json — one file per migration unit. Lifted from v2's state.schema.json $defs/unit.

id.description: Stable identifier (e.g., LoginController, OrderListPage). Used in /web-modernize:migrate <id>, the file name, and notes_path.

depends_on.description: Other unit ids (or __auth__) that must be migrated first.

diagnostic_history.description: Append-only log of every failure diagnostic this unit has seen. Each /retry pushes the current diagnostic here before overwriting failure.diagnostic with the new one.

retry_count.description: Number of times this unit has been retried after a previous failure. Bumped by /web-modernize:retry.

last_retry_prompt.description: The most recent --with-prompt override passed to /web-modernize:retry, or null if never retried with a prompt.

rollback_info.description: Populated by /web-modernize:rollback when a unit is rolled back. Null if never rolled back.

branch.description: The feature branch that was reset/removed, if any.

restored_paths.description: Target files that were reverted (deleted, or restored to pre-migration state).

tests.description: Populated by the unit-migrator's step 7c (translate-or-generate) when state.testing has a real framework. Tracks which legacy tests were translated, which were skipped/untranslatable, how many were generated to top up to target coverage, and the final coverage measurement. Omitted (or carries skipped_reason) when the team chose a manual / n/a runner at /scaffold time.

framework.description: Mirrors the relevant entry of state.testing (vitest, pytest, junit5, xunit, jest, karma-jasmine, manual, n/a, etc.).

skipped_reason.description: Present when framework is 'manual' or 'n/a' — explains why 7c was a no-op.

translated_from.description: Legacy test files successfully ported to the target framework.

skipped_legacy.description: Legacy tests marked disabled (Ignore, Disabled, xit, pytest.mark.skip, etc.) — recorded but not ported.

untranslatable.description: Legacy tests that could not be ported (no target equivalent for the legacy infrastructure they depend on).

generated_count.description: Tests written by 7c to top up to target_pct. Capped at 2 generation passes.

uncovered_regions.description: Present when below_threshold is true. Each entry is one branch/region that 7c could not cover after 2 generation passes.

parity_reviewed_at.description: When the parity-reviewer last compared this unit's source_paths against its target_paths. Lets /verify and /status tell whether parity_findings reflect the current code. Absent/null = never reviewed.

parity_findings.description: Behavioural-parity differences between the legacy source and the migrated target, produced by the parity-reviewer agent (run by /web-modernize:verify's gate or /web-modernize:parity-check). Replaced wholesale on each parity run. A finding with severity 'high' whose id is NOT present in parity_acknowledged_diffs[] blocks the migrated→verified transition.

id.description: Stable, content-derived identifier, e.g. 'output_sort_order:OrderListPage:orderdate-desc-to-asc'. Deterministic from kind + the legacy/migrated behaviour, so an acknowledgement survives a re-run on unchanged code, but a CHANGED behaviour produces a new id and re-surfaces for review.

severity.description: high = a difference an end user / API caller hits on a normal path (regression). medium = edge-case or secondary-path difference. low = unlikely to matter in practice.

legacy.description: Observable legacy behaviour, e.g. "accepts empty 'q' param (returns all rows)".

migrated.description: Observable migrated behaviour, e.g. "rejects empty 'q' with HTTP 400".

file.description: Target file (optionally :line) where the difference is rooted, when locatable.

parity_acknowledged_diffs.description: Parity findings the team reviewed and accepted as intentional. Each entry suppresses the matching parity_findings[] item (by id) from blocking the migrated→verified transition. Filled by /web-modernize:parity-check (interactive prompt or --acknowledge). Survives re-runs; a dormant entry whose id no longer appears in parity_findings[] is harmless.

reason.description: Why this difference is intentional / acceptable.

quality_reviewed_at.description: When the migration-critic last reviewed this unit's target code for idiomatic quality. Absent/null = never reviewed.

quality_headline.description: The migration-critic's one-line 'if I could change one thing' summary from its most recent review.

quality_findings.description: Idiomatic / maintainability findings about the migrated TARGET code, produced by the migration-critic agent (run by /web-modernize:verify's advisory pass or /web-modernize:quality-check). Replaced wholesale on each review. ADVISORY ONLY — quality findings never block the migrated→verified transition (that gate depends solely on lint/typecheck/tests + behavioural parity).

id.description: Stable, content-derived identifier, e.g. 'jobol:OrderListPage:useeffect-postback-emulation'. Deterministic from kind + the observation, so it survives a re-run on unchanged code and a fixed issue drops off.

severity.description: Quality grade. NEVER blocks verification — informational only. 'blocker' means the critic would not approve the code in review, not that the workflow halts.

observation.description: What the critic observed in the target code.

why_it_matters.description: Optional: the maintainability / operability cost if left as-is.

suggestion.description: Optional: a concrete change toward the idiomatic target-stack form.

file.description: Target file (optionally :line) the finding is rooted in.
